rationale.frame_ms: Short-time analysis window for deterministic offline processing.
rationale.low_band_min_hz: Analysis range only; it is not an actuator frequency.
rationale.bed_relative_rms_ratio: Separates sustained texture evidence from isolated peaks.
rationale.bed_peak_percentile: Robust reference level for sustained-bed admission.
rationale.bed_baseline_percentile: Robust background level for transient-dominance detection.
rationale.texture_min_relative_variation: Minimum envelope variation before a shaped texture curve is useful.
rationale.intensity_db_floor: Floor used by the shared logarithmic audio-to-control mapping.
